values.eml_summary: On one machine, align GPU power telemetry, latency, peak memory, memory bandwidth and device occupancy with execution events — the telemetry side that XA-03 already provides — before any claim about data-center energy. Declared as the second v0.2 experiment in the recommended order; the pilot's XA-03 traces are its first raw material, but the alignment study itself has not been run.
values.eml_summary_zh: 在同一台機器上把 GPU 功率遙測、延遲、峰值記憶體、記憶體頻寬與裝置占用對齊到執行事件——XA-03 已提供的遙測面——在任何資料中心能源宣稱之前先做。建議順序中的第二個 v0.2 實驗；pilot 的 XA-03 軌跡是它的第一批原料，但對齊研究本身尚未執行。
values.eml_label_zh: Experiment D——物理軌跡對齊（已宣告）
values.eml_hypothesis: F2 (partial): with operations controlled, time, energy, memory traffic and residency still vary independently; device-level traces can be aligned to semantic-level events.
values.eml_procedure: Same hardware, matched workloads differing in memory pattern; XA-03 telemetry at reduced instrument cost (NVML) aligned to trajectory/tool/verifier spans.
values.eml_interpretation: Declared, not run; listed so the program's falsifiable propositions each have their intended test on record.
eml_limitations: No protocol package exists yet; the canonical index gives the design in one paragraph.
